case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests consistently praised the hotel's tranquil, well-maintained green outdoor spaces, comfortable large rooms, good breakfast and food, and friendly, attentive staff. Positive comments also noted excellent location and overall experience. Some reviews reported ongoing maintenance and suggested the property needs interior and exterior remodeling; others mentioned limited daytime bar/restaurant service and slow bar service attributed to insufficient staffing for the hotel's capacity.
